title: My Calendar II
description: Implement a Calendar class to book events. A booking is allowed if it does not cause a triple booking (three overlapping events).
pseudocode:
1. bookings = []
2. overlaps = []
3. book(start, end):
4.   for overlap in overlaps:
5.     if max(start, overlap.start) < min(end, overlap.end): return false
6.   for book in bookings:
7.     if max(start, book.start) < min(end, book.end):
8.       overlaps.push(intersect(start, end, book.start, book.end))
9.   bookings.push({start, end})
10.  return true

steps.note: Book [15, 25]: Overlaps [10, 20], added to overlaps, success.
Book [10, 25]: Intersects with overlap [15, 20], triple booking detected, return false.
